targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp, 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS time, field_name AS metric, numeric_value AS value
FROM readings
WHERE numeric_value IS NOT NULL
  AND field_name IN ('AT [°C]', 'KT Ist [°C]')
  AND CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp, 'utc') AS INTEGER) >= $__from / 1000
  AND CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp, 'utc') AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000
ORDER BY time ASC
